editorial:
Get ready for a wild ride this holiday season with a story that blends magic, family drama, and plenty of laughs. You will follow Igor, a stubborn businessman who thinks money solves everything until a fortune teller puts a curse on him. To break the spell, he has to do the one thing he has avoided for years: find and reconnect with the daughter he ignored. The movie feels like a warm hug with a chaotic twist, jumping between different lives that all crash together in a big New Year's celebration. It is the perfect mix of silly humor and heartfelt moments that make you think about your own family.

The acting is great, especially the chemistry between the grumpy lead and the eccentric psychic, Aleksandr Sheps. The pacing moves quickly, so you never feel bored, though some of the shorter side stories feel a bit rushed. If you love movies that make you laugh and cry at the same time, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the bright city lights, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy night in with some popcorn.
endingExplained: In the end, Igor realizes that his wealth means nothing compared to his child. After a series of funny mishaps, he finally finds his daughter and asks for her forgiveness. The moment they embrace, the curse lifts immediately. The final scene shows all the different characters meeting up in a big square, proving that everyone is connected by magic. It wraps up with a happy party where Igor starts his new life as a loving father.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good holiday movies and family comedies.
